mlworkflow.why: The workflow is an ordered process best seen step by step, then made a habit by running it on real datasets.

featureeng.why: Feature skills stick by transforming messy tables often; the flowchart shows how Pipeline and ColumnTransformer fit together.

linreg.why: Dragging the learning rate and stepping gradient descent makes loss, overshoot and overfitting visible before the math.

logreg.why: Moving weights and watching the boundary, log loss and accuracy change builds intuition for probabilities and thresholds.
